entries.022429bc775c4ef7: This is a business of bicycle parking products under the company's own brand. For bicycle parking products such as bicycle racks, it handles everything from planning and development to design, manufacturing, sales and installation, maintenance, and operation of bicycle parking facilities. The Tokyo Sales Office in Taito-ku, Tokyo is the facility for this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥494 million.
entries.0b9f799cad6c8181: This is a business of made-to-order products received from automobile manufacturers. Mainly through sheet metal work, painting and resin molding, the company manufactures and sells exterior parts such as bumpers and spoilers, and a hand brake lever system. The Nishino Plant and Shimonara Plant in Kumagaya City, Saitama Prefecture are the production facilities for this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,619 million.
entries.0e43354eb0320815: It is a business model that manufactures and sells resin-molded, sheet-metal, and painted parts such as bumpers ordered from automakers, and its own products centered on bicycle parking racks.
entries.15840a1be678937b: Net loss for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥69 million. The loss narrowed from the prior year's net loss of ¥104 million.

entries.40915fdb92ec341f: In the automotive parts division, the company states that it is focusing on expanding its development and design functions to increase Tier 1 orders for mass-produced items from major customers, and aims to expand orders centered on resin-molded and resin-painted automotive exterior parts, its strength. In the own-products division, the company states that it aims to expand its business by extending its sales areas and channels, leveraging its system of handling everything in the bicycle parking business from planning and development through design, manufacturing, sales and installation, to maintenance.
entries.4efdd3a8b36e0519: This is a business of bicycle parking products under the company's own brand.
entries.689c46b557ff0a79: The company, which has strengths in resin molding and resin painting of automotive exterior parts, states that it is expanding investment in R&D on technologies for vehicle weight reduction, new materials, and new special painting techniques, such as its annealing-less technology, which it patented in September 2022. In the bicycle parking business, the company has taken over the "Shinwa-type Bicycle Parking System," which has a 40-year history and a record of installing 600,000 bicycle racks, and its strength is in-house design and development.
